question: Who won his first major Indian Golf Union title, the IGU Southern India Junior Boys Golf Championship, played at Coimbatore Golf Club from 27 May to 30 May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harjai Milkha Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Harjai Milkha Singh** secured his maiden major **Indian Golf Union (IGU)** title by winning the **IGU Southern India Junior Boys Golf Championship**.
 
• The championship was held at the **Coimbatore Golf Club**, located in **Chettipalayam**, **Tamil Nadu**, from **27 May to 30 May 2025**.
 
• **Harjai**, the son of the legendary Indian golfer **Jeev Milkha Singh**, demonstrated exceptional composure and skill over the **four-day** tournament to clinch the trophy in the **Category A** segment.
 
• This victory marks a significant breakthrough in his junior career, following in the footsteps of his father and grandfather in the realm of **Indian sports**.
 
• The tournament featured top-tier junior talent from across the country, making **Harjai's** win a testament to his rising status in the **national golf circuit**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Indian Golf Union (IGU)**:
 
 
• The **IGU** was founded in **1955** and serves as the apex governing body for golf in **India**.
 
• It is responsible for maintaining the **National Handicap System** and organizing national-level amateur and junior championships.
 
• The **IGU** is affiliated with the **International Golf Federation** and play a vital role in selecting the **Indian national team** for international events like the **Asian Games** and **Olympics**.
 
 
 
• **Coimbatore Golf Club**:
 
 
• This **18-hole** course is situated on the outskirts of **Coimbatore** and is known for its challenging layout and strong **wind conditions**, which test a golfer's accuracy and ball control.
 
• It frequently hosts major tournaments on the **IGU Junior Tour** and the **Professional Golf Tour of India (PGTI)**.
 
 
 
• **Milkha Singh Family Legacy**:
 
 
• **Harjai Milkha Singh** represents the third generation of one of India's most iconic sporting families.
 
• His grandfather, **Milkha Singh**, famously known as the **"Flying Sikh,"** was a legendary sprinter who represented **India** in multiple **Olympics**.
 
• His father, **Jeev Milkha Singh**, was the first Indian golfer to join the **European Tour** and has won numerous titles on the **Asian Tour** and **Japan Golf Tour**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Junior Golf Categories**: The **IGU** divides junior tournaments into specific age groups. **Category A** typically involves players aged **15 to 17**, while **Category B** includes those aged **13 to 14**. **Harjai Milkha Singh** has been a prominent figure in these divisions as he progresses toward the amateur ranks.
 
• **Significance of the Title**: Winning an **IGU major** is a prerequisite for climbing the **National Order of Merit**. High rankings in this system allow young golfers to represent **India** at prestigious international amateur tournaments.
 
• **Other Options**:
 
 
• **Shubhankar Sharma** and **Gaganjeet Bhullar** are established **professional golfers** who have already won multiple international titles on the **European** and **Asian Tours**.
 
• **Shiv Kapur** is an **Asian Games gold medalist** and a veteran of the professional circuit, distinguishably different from the junior category winners.
